name: 8x Intel Gaudi 2 HL-225B, MLPerf v4.0 offline: Llama-2-70B FP8 aggregate output tok/s
unit: output tok/s AGGREGATE across 8x Gaudi 2 (batch-1024 class; ~1004 tok/s per module)
methodology: VENDOR-MEASURED (MLPerf v4.0 offline submission, Intel). 8x Gaudi 2 HL-225B: 8,034.85 output tok/s AGGREGATE on Llama-2-70B FP8. Per-module ~1,004 tok/s at batch-1024 - THIS IS NOT A SINGLE-USER DECODE NUMBER. Respectable per-module throughput, but it is batch-1024 serving measured on a chassis that a hobbyist cannot practically buy or power.
notes: TRAP for solo use. The MLPerf number is real but the HARDWARE PATH is the trap: HL-225 is OAM-only, has no PCIe SKU, and needs the Gaudi UBB chassis (Supermicro 820GH-TNR2 ~$11,995 for the 8-module baseboard) plus a 24x 100GbE fabric to even light up - you cannot put one in a workstation. Bare module ~$1,500-2,700; the rumoured $700-900 market is NOT showing on eBay Oct-2026 - treat that figure as stale. SynapseAI/vLLM-fork works but the ecosystem is thin and Intel is winding the line down.
